sections: In-Ear, On-Ear oder Over-Ear?

In-Ears sind am kleinsten und passen in jede Hosentasche, ideal für Pendeln und Sport. On-Ears liegen auf der Ohrmuschel, sind leicht, schirmen aber wenig ab. Over-Ears umschließen das Ohr, dämpfen passiv besser und sind bei langen Sessions oft bequemer.
Brauchst du ANC?

Aktive Geräuschunterdrückung lohnt sich vor allem in Bus, Bahn und Großraumbüro. Wenn du hauptsächlich zu Hause oder beim Spazierengehen hörst, reicht ein Modell ohne ANC, und du sparst oft Geld oder bekommst mehr Akkulaufzeit.
Akku und Multipoint

en.answer: If you want to block out noise, get the Soundcore P31i: they are the only model here with active noise cancellation (ANC). For small, light earbuds with great sound, the Sony WF-C510 are the best pick. If you prefer headphones with a headband, the Sony WH-CH520 is the cheapest way in and the JBL Tune 730BT has the longest battery life.
en.intro: We did not test these headphones in our own lab. This guide is based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews (including TechRadar, Tom's Guide and Notebookcheck) and current deal prices from 20 Oct 2026. Battery figures are manufacturer claims unless stated otherwise.

soundcore-p31i.label: Best all-rounder with ANC
soundcore-p31i.why: According to Anker, the P31i offer ANC with up to 52 dB of reduction, LDAC for high-res streaming and multipoint. IP55 makes them fine for workouts, and the claimed battery life is up to 50 hours with the case.

sony-wf-c510.label: Best sound on the go
sony-wf-c510.why: TechRadar praises the clear, punchy sound and comfortable fit and gives them full marks for value. There is no ANC, but you get an adjustable ambient mode, multipoint and up to 11 hours per charge. The case only adds one extra charge, though.

sony-wh-ch520.label: Budget on-ear pick
sony-wh-ch520.why: For under €30, Sony claims up to 50 hours of battery, plus multipoint and an equalizer. Tom's Guide likes the sound and battery but criticises the weak microphone. There is no ANC, and as an on-ear model it sits on your ears rather than around them.

jbl-tune-730bt.label: Longest battery life
jbl-tune-730bt.why: JBL claims up to 76 hours of playback, and 5 minutes of charging should give you 5 hours. You also get Bluetooth 6.0 with LE Audio and multipoint. As an over-ear model it isolates better than an on-ear, but it has no active noise cancellation.

sections: In-ear, on-ear or over-ear?

Earbuds are the smallest and fit in any pocket, great for commuting and workouts. On-ear headphones rest on your ears, are light but block little noise. Over-ear models surround your ears, isolate better passively and are often more comfortable for long sessions.
Do you need ANC?

Active noise cancellation is most useful on buses, trains and in open-plan offices. If you mostly listen at home or on walks, a model without ANC is fine, and you often save money or get more battery life.
Battery and multipoint

All four models support multipoint, so they can stay connected to your phone and laptop at the same time. With true wireless earbuds, look at how often the case can recharge them, not just the time per charge. For headband models, 50 hours or more is now common in this price range.
faq: Which headphones under €60 have ANC?
In this comparison, only the Soundcore P31i. The Sony WF-C510, Sony WH-CH520 and JBL Tune 730BT do not have active noise cancellation.
Do they work with iPhone and Android?
Yes, all four are standard Bluetooth headphones and work with both. Some features, such as LDAC on the P31i, only work on Android.
Which pair lasts the longest?
According to the manufacturer, the JBL Tune 730BT with up to 76 hours. The Sony WH-CH520 is rated for up to 50 hours.
Are the Sony WF-C510 good for sports?
They are IPX4 splash resistant and very light, which is fine for sweaty workouts. For rain and dust, the IP55-rated P31i are better protected.

sections: Set oder Einzel-Soundbar?

Ein Set mit Subwoofer und Rücklautsprechern wie die Hisense sorgt für echten Raumklang, braucht aber Platz und Steckdosen hinter dem Sofa. Eine Einzel-Soundbar wie die Bose ist aufgeräumter und passt besser in kleine Räume, liefert aber weniger Bass.
Worauf du beim Anschluss achten solltest

Am besten verbindest du die Soundbar per HDMI eARC oder ARC mit dem Fernseher. Dann steuerst du die Lautstärke mit der TV-Fernbedienung. Für Dolby Atmos von Streaming-Apps sollte dein TV eARC unterstützen.
Musik streamen

Wenn du viel Musik über die Soundbar hörst, ist WLAN mit AirPlay 2 oder Chromecast komfortabler als Bluetooth. Das bietet in diesem Vergleich nur die Bose. Hisense und Denon kannst du nur per Bluetooth mit Musik versorgen.

Unterstützt die Denon DHT-S316 Dolby Atmos?
Nein. Sie spielt Dolby Digital und DTS ab, mischt den Ton aber auf ihr 2.1-System herunter.
Brauche ich HDMI eARC?
Für Dolby Atmos über HDMI ist eARC empfehlenswert. Für normalen TV-Ton reicht auch ARC oder ein optisches Kabel.

A set with subwoofer and rear speakers like the Hisense gives you real surround sound, but it needs space and power sockets behind the sofa. A single bar like the Bose is tidier and suits small rooms better, but delivers less bass.

Ideally connect the soundbar to your TV via HDMI eARC or ARC. That way you control the volume with your TV remote. For Dolby Atmos from streaming apps, your TV should support eARC.

anthbot-m5-maehroboter.label: For small gardens up to 500 m²

It combines RTK navigation with two cameras that take over when the satellite signal is weak, and it has a rain sensor and IPX6 protection. In the o2 Community check, setup took about ten minutes. anthbot-m9-maehroboter.why: The M9 shares many specs with the M5, but ANTHBOT rates it for up to 1,000 m². PC-WELT lists a 5 Ah battery, praises the fast mapping and precise cut, and says obstacle detection still has room for improvement. In their test, the M9 briefly got stuck between chair legs.

anthbot-genie-800-refurbished.why: According to the Euronics review, the Genie 800 uses full-band RTK and four 3D cameras. sections: RTK or cameras: how does the mower find its way?

Wire-free robot mowers usually rely on RTK. Satellite data is combined with correction data from a reference station in your garden or from the mobile network (network RTK) for centimetre-level accuracy. Cameras help detect obstacles and take over when trees or walls block the signal. All three models here combine RTK with cameras. Check beforehand that your garden has enough open sky for the antenna.
Getting lawn size and slope right

The maximum area is a manufacturer figure under good conditions. Many zones, narrow passages and awkward corners cost time, so leave some headroom. ANTHBOT says all three mowers handle slopes up to 45%, but very steep or wet slopes remain a borderline case.
App, 4G and running costs

The basics work without internet. The app mainly makes zones, schedules and cutting height easier to manage. Watch the follow-up costs: according to PC-WELT and the o2 Community, the 4G connection costs around €40 a year after the free period, and theft tracking needs that subscription too. PC-WELT also says network RTK on the M9 is paid after three free months. The mowers' Wi-Fi only supports the 2.4 GHz band.
Theft protection

A wire-free mower often sits in plain sight. Useful features are a PIN lock, an alarm when it leaves the mapped area, and GPS tracking. Tracking usually needs a mobile connection, so budget for the subscription if that protection matters to you. It is also worth checking whether your home contents insurance covers it.
Winter storage

Clean the body, blade disc and wheels thoroughly and store the mower somewhere dry and frost-free, such as a basement. Charge the battery first so it does not fully discharge over winter, and follow the manual. Depending on the manufacturer, you can leave the charging station and RTK antenna outside or take them in too. If you buy now, you may only set it up in spring, but the return window starts on delivery.
Which mower suits which garden?

Terraced house or small family garden up to 500 m²: M5. Typical garden up to 1,000 m² with several zones: M9. Larger area, tight budget and fine with a refurbished unit: Genie 800. ANTHBOT's Halloween Sale runs until 30 Oct 2026, after which regular prices are likely to return.
faq: Do these mowers really work without a boundary wire?
Yes. You set the boundaries in the app by letting the mower drive the lawn edge once or by steering it manually. It determines its position using RTK and cameras.

According to ANTHBOT, from 12 to 30 Oct 2026. Prices may change after that.
Are there costs after buying?
Possibly. Reviews say the 4G connection costs around €40 a year after the free period. You need it for remote control on the go and theft tracking. Mowing itself works without it.
Is a refurbished robot mower worth it?

Often yes, if the discount is big. For the Genie 800, ANTHBOT mentions tested units with possible light signs of use, a 1-year warranty and 30-day returns. New units come with a 3-year warranty according to ANTHBOT.
Can I leave the mower outside in winter?
Better not. Store it clean, charged and frost-free. The manual explains what to do with the charging station and antenna.

Working out running costs

Electricity costs depend on three things: the consumption per cycle on the label, your electricity price and how often you wash or dry. Singles and couples often manage with 6 to 7 kg, families benefit from 8 kg or more. A dryer drum can be larger than the washer's, because laundry needs room to dry. So a 7 kg washer and a 9 kg dryer work well together.
Noise

For washing machines, the label shows the noise during the spin cycle, the loudest phase. For dryers, the figure refers to the drying cycle. If the appliance sits in your flat or near a bedroom, check this value and use delay start so it runs when it does not bother you.
Stacking and installation

Many dryers can be stacked on a washer with a matching stacking kit. This usually only works with appliances of the same width and a kit approved by the manufacturer. cosori-airfryer-dual-2-koerbe.why: Zwei getrennte Kammern nebeneinander, laut Angebot 1.750 W. sections: Zwei Körbe oder ein großer?

Zwei Körbe garen Beilage und Hauptgericht gleichzeitig mit verschiedenen Temperaturen; per Sync-Funktion werden beide zur selben Zeit fertig. Ein großer, teilbarer Korb wie beim FlexDrawer ist flexibler, wenn du auch mal ein ganzes Hähnchen oder eine Lasagne machen willst.
Stellfläche messen
Geräte mit zwei Körben nebeneinander sind breit. Der Double Stack stapelt die Körbe und braucht deshalb weniger Fläche, ist dafür höher. Miss vor dem Kauf auch die Höhe unter den Hängeschränken.
Literangaben richtig lesen
Die Literzahl beschreibt das Korbvolumen, nicht die Menge Pommes. Bei zwei Körben zählt, wie viel in einen einzelnen Korb passt.
Reinigung
Körbe und Gitter sind bei allen drei Geräten spülmaschinenfest. Große Körbe wie beim FlexDrawer belegen aber fast einen ganzen Spülmaschinenkorb.
faq: Welche Heißluftfritteuse mit 2 Körben braucht am wenigsten Platz?
Von unseren drei Deals die Ninja Double Stack XL: Ihre Körbe liegen übereinander, die Stellfläche beträgt rund 28 × 47 cm.
Kann man beim Ninja FlexDrawer beide Zonen unterschiedlich einstellen?
Ja, mit eingesetztem Trenner hat jede Zone ihre eigene Heizung. Laut Futura-Test isoliert der Trenner bei sehr großen Temperaturunterschieden aber nicht vollständig.
Ist der Cosori mit 2 Körben wirklich Testsieger?
Cosori und Händler bewerben ihn so, PC Games Hardware nennt die Stiftung-Warentest-Ausgabe 01/2025. Ob dieselbe Variante getestet wurde, lässt sich ohne den Test selbst nicht sicher sagen.
Wie viel Strom braucht eine Heißluftfritteuse?
Die Geräte hier haben 1.750 bis 2.470 W Nennleistung. Weil sie schneller heiß sind als ein Backofen, ist der Verbrauch für kleine Portionen meist geringer.

en.title: Dual-basket air fryer 2026: Ninja vs. Cosori compared
en.desc: Ninja Double Stack XL, Ninja FlexDrawer or Cosori dual basket? Capacity, footprint, test scores and current deal prices at a glance.
en.answer: Little counter space: Ninja Double Stack XL, its two baskets are stacked. Big family or whole chickens: Ninja Foodi FlexDrawer, its 10.4-litre drawer can be split or used as one large zone. Cheapest way into two separate baskets: the Cosori dual-basket air fryer.
en.intro: We have not tested these appliances ourselves. Specs and test results come from manufacturers and independent reviews (home&smart, Futura, PC Games Hardware); prices are our Amazon deal prices from 17 Nov 2026 (compared with Amazon's list price).

ninja-double-stack-xl-9-5l.label: Space-saving: stacked baskets
ninja-double-stack-xl-9-5l.why: 9.5 litres in two stacked drawers (4.75 l each), 2,470 W, footprint only about 28 × 47 cm. home&smart rates it 81/100 ("good", 05/2025): easy to use and clean, good results with pizza, rolls and potatoes. Weakness: fries brown unevenly at times, and there is no shake reminder.

ninja-foodi-flexdrawer-10-4l.label: Largest cavity, splittable
ninja-foodi-flexdrawer-10-4l.why: One large 10.4-litre drawer that a divider splits into two 5.2-litre zones with separate heating; without the divider it fits a whole chicken. 2,470 W, 35–240 °C. Futura found it efficient and fairly quiet (max. 48 dB), but bulky, with a short cord (about 80 cm), and the divider does not fully insulate very different temperatures.

cosori-airfryer-dual-2-koerbe.label: Cheapest dual-basket entry
cosori-airfryer-dual-2-koerbe.why: Two separate baskets side by side, 1,750 W according to the listing. Cosori advertises it as a Stiftung Warentest winner; PC Games Hardware cites issue 01/2025 for the Cosori Dual Basket. We could not verify that exactly this variant was tested – the score is behind test.de's paywall.

sections: Two baskets or one big one?

Two baskets cook a side and a main at different temperatures at the same time; sync mode makes both finish together. One large splittable drawer like the FlexDrawer is more flexible if you also want to cook a whole chicken or a lasagne.
Measure your counter
Side-by-side dual-basket models are wide. The Double Stack stacks its baskets, so it needs less footprint but more height. Check the clearance under your wall cabinets too.
Reading capacity figures
Litres describe basket volume, not how many fries fit. With two baskets, what matters is how much fits into a single one.
Cleaning
Baskets and racks are dishwasher-safe on all three. Large drawers like the FlexDrawer take up almost a whole dishwasher rack, though.
faq: Which dual-basket air fryer needs the least space?
Of our three deals, the Ninja Double Stack XL: its baskets are stacked and the footprint is about 28 × 47 cm.
Can both FlexDrawer zones run at different settings?
Yes, with the divider inserted each zone has its own heating. According to Futura, the divider does not fully insulate very large temperature differences.
Is the Cosori dual basket really a test winner?
Cosori and retailers advertise it that way, and PC Games Hardware cites Stiftung Warentest issue 01/2025. Without the test itself we cannot confirm it was the same variant.
How much power does an air fryer use?
The models here are rated 1,750 to 2,470 W. Because they heat up faster than an oven, they usually use less energy for small portions.
